library_empty_body: A track stops you? Keep it: it will wait for you here.

about_body: AubeSonore is a discovery radio. Every week, tracks found around a reference library are ranked one by one by a taste model; only the best ranked go on air. Free, ad-free, non-commercial.

auth_error_password_length: Your password must be at least 6 characters long.
toast_forgot_sent: If an account exists, an email has just been sent.
toast_password_reset: Password updated. You can sign in now.
hero_title: A discovery radio, chosen track by track.
hero_tagline: Free. No ads. Day and night.
